subject: Request: Audit log retention & BYOK exception — onboarding checklist
messages:
From: Alyssa Cole <alyssa.cole@securebank.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Cc: SecureBank Procurement <procurement@securebank.com>; security@securebank.com
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Audit logs / BYOK questions for onboarding

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team liked the throughput numbers. We're starting the vendor onboarding packet and have a couple of compliance items that need confirmation before procurement will sign. Main asks: 

- Audit log retention: SecureBank needs server-side audit logs retained for 7 years for certain regulated datasets. Can Redwood support a retention policy that differs by customer dataset classification?
- BYOK/KMS: We must bring our own keys for customer data at rest. Is there an option to integrate our KMS (AWS KMS with HSM-backed CMKs) into a private deployment or via a managed connector?
- SSO & SCIM: We need SSO + automated group provisioning; please confirm SCIM v2 support and SAML IdP metadata exchange process.

Procurement also asked if you can complete the short retention-exception form (attached) and return with any SOC2 certificate extracts. Can you route this to the right folks?

Attaching: retention-exception-form.docx

Appreciate a timeline — procurement would like this wrapped in 5 business days.

Thanks,
Alyssa
Alyssa Cole
Director, Vendor Risk — SecureBank
alyssa.cole@securebank.com
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Alyssa Cole <alyssa.cole@securebank.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Audit logs / BYOK questions for onboarding

Looping you all in — SecureBank (Alyssa) started the onboarding packet and has three discrete asks: retention-by-class, BYOK/KMS integration option, and SCIM/SAML for SSO. Procurement wants the retention-exception form completed and SOC2 extracts.

Quick asks from product/security side:
- Evelyn: can Redwood Hosted offer per-customer retention windows configurable by dataset/class, or is that only on Private? If Hosted, what are the operational controls + rates?
- Vivek: for BYOK, can Dedicated/Private accept external AWS KMS CMKs via an HSM-backed flow? If not, what is the recommended pattern (bring-your-own-key on Private, or key-escrow + HSM on Dedicated)?
- Marcus: SCIM v2 + SAML SSO — do we have a standard onboarding checklist and metadata exchange template we can hand to SecureBank?

Procurement would like a 5-business-day turnaround on the form. I will log a Jira (INF-879) for tracking. Attaching the retention form from SecureBank.

Thanks — can each of you reply inline with answers / blockers by EOD tomorrow so I can circle back to Alyssa.

—Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Apr 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Audit logs / BYOK questions for onboarding

Stephanie — quick triage notes (cc Marcus/Evelyn):

- BYOK/KMS: Private deployments (VPC or on-prem) already support customer-managed KMS integration; customers can bring AWS KMS CMKs and we integrate via a customer-managed KMS endpoint + HSM. For Dedicated (hosted single-tenant pools), we can offer a KMS connector but it requires a customer-approved KMS proxy and an architecture review. Short answer: BYOK is fully supported for Private; supported on Dedicated with architecture review and extra ops steps.

- Audit retention: Hosted (multi-tenant) currently provides a global retention policy with configurable buckets (30/90/365 days) but not per-dataset 7-year retention. Private supports arbitrary retention windows configured during onboarding. We can offer a retention-exception for Hosted customers, but it requires legal/ops sign-off and will increase storage costs and SLO exceptions.

- SCIM/SAML: We have SCIM v2 support for group provisioning (standard endpoints) and SAML integrations; Marcus can attach the metadata template.

Blockers / next steps:
1) Product needs to confirm if we'll accept a Hosted exception for 7yrs or require Private. If Hosted exception, ops needs written consent and billing adjustment (estimate).
2) Security needs SecureBank's KMS architecture diagram for Dedicated connector path.
3) Marcus to provide SAML metadata template & SCIM endpoints.

I'll prepare a short ops statement and cost delta estimate if they want Hosted exception.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Security & Trust — Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Cole <alyssa.cole@securebank.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, SecureBank Procurement <procurement@securebank.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2026 15:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Audit logs / BYOK questions for onboarding

Alyssa — thanks for the clear list. Quick summary and proposed next steps: 

1) BYOK/KMS: We can support AWS KMS CMKs in a Private deployment (customer-managed KMS endpoint + HSM). For Dedicated, we can do a KMS connector but it requires an architecture review and approval; please send your KMS diagram to security@redwood.com.

2) Audit log retention: 7-year per-dataset retention is supported on Private. For Hosted, we can offer a retention-exception for this engagement but it will be a non-standard SLO (requires legal/ops sign-off and a storage surcharge). If you prefer the exception route, please confirm and we'll return the signed exception form.

3) SSO/SCIM: We support SAML IdP and SCIM v2 group provisioning. Attached is our standard metadata template and the SCIM endpoint doc.

Attached: securebank-soc2-summary.pdf (SOC2 extract), retention-exception-form.docx (filled with our proposed exception language).

Proposed timeline:
- Today (Fri): SecureBank reviews SOC2 extract + retention exception language.
- Mon/Tue: If SecureBank confirms Hosted exception, we'll route to Legal & Ops for sign-off and provide a final estimate for storage delta (2-3 business days). If SecureBank opts for Private, we'll trigger onboarding and schedule architecture review for KMS (target week of May 4).

Documents / links: DocuSign onboarding packet: https://app.docusign.com/securebank/onboarding-SB-0420
Jira tracker: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-879

Let me know which path you prefer and I will coordinate next steps.

Best,
—Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.com
